formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (n : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (u : ℕ) (sigma : ℕ → ℕ) (x : Fin n → Bool), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → u < C.gates.length → (∀ r : ℕ, sigma r < n + u) → ((∀ r < C.gates.length, n + u ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C r).inputs → (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (sigma r) false = true → (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (n + u) false = true) → ∀ i : ℕ, ((PEqualNP.FactorSubst.substReads C n u sigma).wires (List.ofFn x)).getD i false = true → (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD i false = true) ∧ ((∀ r < C.gates.length, n + u ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C r).inputs → (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (sigma r) false = (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (n + u) false) → (PEqualNP.FactorSubst.substReads C n u sigma).wires (List.ofFn x) = C.wires (List.ofFn x)))
plain_statement: It is false that: C: AND/OR gates on n inputs, each reading exactly two earlier wires; u a gate; for each gate r, sigma r a wire earlier than gate u. Fix an input x. (a) If at x each wire sigma r, for r reading gate u, is true only if gate u's wire is, then after replacing every read of gate u by r with sigma r (nothing renumbered), every wire is true at x only if the same wire of C is. (b) If at x each such sigma r equals gate u's wire, every new wire equals the same wire of C at x.
title: It is false that replacing reads of a gate by earlier wires below (equal to) it keeps every wire below (equal) (exact fan-in-two AND/OR circuits)
